title: Embed configured boards without taking over the host app
description:
As an app developer I want to embed the existing Kanbus board with my domain configuration so my application owns navigation and data access.

Feature: Embedded Kanbus
  Scenario: Render a domain board
    Given a host provides prospect issues and sales-funnel statuses
    When it renders the reusable Kanbus component
    Then columns use the configured names and selecting a prospect calls the host callback
    And the host controls data access, routing and authentication
  Scenario: Preserve standalone usage
    Given the existing standalone console configuration
    When the console builds and renders its board
    Then existing board behavior remains available
